summary: Vuzix Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $100 million of common stock through Jefferies as sales agent, replacing a prior sales agreement. The offering is part of a $300 million shelf registration. Jefferies receives a 3.0% commission. No escrow arrangement exists. The filing is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. What to watch: potential dilution from ATM sales, but no strategic event.
